newsitem.title: USA: Schult Homes expanding its capacity.
newsitem.headline: Schult Homes expanding its capacity.

text.p: Schult Homes Corp, which produces manufactured homes, said Thursday it plans an expansion at its Navasota, Texas facility and will apply the Navasota model to two other plants -- Etna Green, Ind. and Buckeye, Ariz.
When the expanded capacity comes on line during fiscal 1998 and 1999, it will give the company $90 million of additional manufacturing capacity annually, said president Walter Wells in a statement.

"All three facilities will add lines designed specifically to manufacture a high-volume, package home for the entry level buyer without the need for separate plant management or administrative staff," Wells noted.
